metadata.description: Domain model for a complete B2C e-commerce platform supporting order management, payments, shipping, inventory, and customer management.

objectives: Enable customers to browse products and place orders online
Provide customer support and account management

sharedKernel.description: Value Objects shared across multiple Bounded Contexts via Published Language

valueObjects.name: Money
invariants: amount must be non-negative
currency must be a valid ISO 4217 code
for MVP, currency must be EUR

valueObjects.name: Address
invariants: for MVP domestic shipping only: country must be IT or follow the configured allowed list

coreDomains.name: Order Management
coreDomains.description: Handles the complete lifecycle of customer orders from creation to completion.

ubiquitousLanguage.Order: A customer's confirmed intent to purchase one or more products, with associated delivery and payment details
ubiquitousLanguage.OrderLine: A single product entry within an order, including quantity and price snapshot at time of order
ubiquitousLanguage.OrderStatus: The current state of an order in its lifecycle (Draft, Confirmed, Paid, FulfillmentInProgress, Shipped, Delivered, Cancelled, Refunded)
ubiquitousLanguage.Cart: A temporary collection of products a customer intends to purchase
ubiquitousLanguage.Checkout: The process of converting a cart into a confirmed order

entities.name: Order
invariants: order must have at least one orderLine
all money values must have currency = EUR for MVP
subTotal must equal sum(orderLines.lineTotal)
totalAmount must equal subTotal + shippingFee + taxAmount - discountAmount (if present)
order cannot be modified after status is Shipped

entities.name: OrderLine
invariants: quantity must be >= 1
unitPrice.amount must be >= 0
lineTotal must equal unitPrice * quantity (same currency)

valueObjects.name: Money
valueObjects.note: Shared VO - canonical definition in sharedKernel
invariants: amount must be non-negative
currency must be EUR for MVP

valueObjects.name: Address
valueObjects.note: Shared VO - canonical definition in sharedKernel
invariants: for MVP domestic shipping only: country must be IT

functionalRequirements.description: Customer can create an order from their cart
Customer can view their order history
Customer can cancel an order before shipping
System calculates order total including taxes and shipping fee

coreDomains.name: Product Catalog
coreDomains.description: Manages product information, categories, pricing, and availability.

ubiquitousLanguage.Product: An item available for sale with associated description, images, and pricing
ubiquitousLanguage.Category: A grouping of related products for navigation and organization
ubiquitousLanguage.SKU: Stock Keeping Unit - unique identifier for a specific product variant
ubiquitousLanguage.Price: The current selling price of a product in EUR
ubiquitousLanguage.Availability: Whether a product is currently purchasable by customers

entities.name: Product
invariants: sku must be unique across all products
price.amount must be > 0
price.currency must be EUR for MVP

entities.name: Category
invariants: name must be unique among sibling categories
parentCategoryId must reference an existing Active Category if present

valueObjects.name: Money
valueObjects.note: Shared VO - canonical definition in sharedKernel
invariants: amount must be > 0 for product prices
currency must be EUR for MVP

functionalRequirements.description: Customer can browse products by category
Customer can search products by name or description
Admin can add, update, and remove products

supportingDomains.name: Payment Processing
supportingDomains.description: Handles payment authorization, capture, and refunds. Exclusively supports Order Management.

ubiquitousLanguage.Payment: A financial transaction associated with a confirmed order
ubiquitousLanguage.PaymentMethod: The means by which a customer pays (card, bank transfer, digital wallet)
ubiquitousLanguage.PaymentStatus: The current state of a payment (Pending, Authorized, Captured, Failed, Refunded)
ubiquitousLanguage.Refund: A full or partial reversal of a captured payment, returning funds to the customer

entities.name: Payment
invariants: amount.currency must be EUR for MVP
amount.amount must be > 0
orderId must reference an existing confirmed order
a Refund can only be issued for a Payment in Captured status

valueObjects.name: Money
valueObjects.note: Shared VO - canonical definition in sharedKernel
invariants: amount must be non-negative
currency must be EUR for MVP

functionalRequirements.description: System processes payment authorization when order is confirmed
System captures payment after successful stock reservation
System supports full refunds for cancelled orders

supportingDomains.name: Shipping & Delivery
supportingDomains.description: Manages shipment creation, carrier integration, and delivery tracking. Exclusively supports Order Management.

ubiquitousLanguage.Shipment: A physical package containing ordered items to be delivered to a customer
ubiquitousLanguage.Carrier: A third-party logistics provider used to deliver shipments
ubiquitousLanguage.TrackingNumber: A unique carrier-issued identifier for tracking a shipment's transit progress
ubiquitousLanguage.DeliveryStatus: The current state of a shipment in transit (Preparing, Dispatched, InTransit, Delivered, Returned)

entities.name: Shipment
invariants: orderId must reference an existing paid order
trackingNumber is set only after status transitions to Dispatched
destinationAddress is a snapshot of the Order's shippingAddress at time of shipment creation

valueObjects.name: Address
valueObjects.note: Shared VO - canonical definition in sharedKernel. Stored as a snapshot for delivery immutability.
invariants: country must be IT for MVP domestic shipping

functionalRequirements.description: System automatically creates a shipment when an order transitions to Paid status
Customer can track their shipment status via tracking number

supportingDomains.name: Customer Management
supportingDomains.description: Manages customer profiles, addresses, and authentication identity. Supports Order Management.

ubiquitousLanguage.Customer: A registered user who can browse the catalog and place orders
ubiquitousLanguage.CustomerProfile: Personal and contact details associated with a customer account
ubiquitousLanguage.SavedAddress: A delivery address stored by a customer for convenient reuse at checkout

entities.name: Customer
invariants: email must be unique across all customers
a Deleted customer cannot place new orders

valueObjects.name: Email
invariants: value must match a valid RFC 5322 email format

valueObjects.name: Address
valueObjects.note: Shared VO - canonical definition in sharedKernel
invariants: country must be IT for MVP domestic shipping

functionalRequirements.description: Customer can register and manage their account profile
Customer can save up to 5 delivery addresses for reuse

supportingDomains.name: Inventory Management
supportingDomains.description: Tracks stock levels and manages reservations for pending orders. Supports Product Catalog and Order Management.

ubiquitousLanguage.StockItem: A record tracking on-hand and reserved quantity for a specific product SKU
ubiquitousLanguage.OnHandQuantity: The total physical units of a product currently available in the warehouse
ubiquitousLanguage.ReservedQuantity: Units temporarily held for confirmed but not yet fulfilled orders
ubiquitousLanguage.Reservation: A temporary hold on stock units for a specific order, released on fulfillment or cancellation
ubiquitousLanguage.Restock: An incoming addition of new inventory units for a product SKU

entities.name: StockItem
invariants: onHandQuantity must be >= 0
reservedQuantity must be >= 0
reservedQuantity must be <= onHandQuantity
availableQuantity = onHandQuantity - reservedQuantity must be >= 0

functionalRequirements.description: System reserves stock units when a new order is created
System releases reserved stock when an order is cancelled
System marks a StockItem as OutOfStock when a product is discontinued in the catalog

genericDomains.name: Notification Service
genericDomains.description: Handles sending transactional emails, SMS, and push notifications to customers and internal teams.
genericDomains.implementationStrategy: Use third-party service (SendGrid for email, Twilio for SMS). No custom business logic.

functionalRequirements.description: System sends order confirmation email to customer after order creation
System sends shipping notification with tracking number when shipment is dispatched

genericDomains.name: Authentication & Authorization
genericDomains.description: Handles user login, session management, and role-based access control.
genericDomains.implementationStrategy: Use identity provider (Auth0 or Keycloak). No custom business logic.

functionalRequirements.description: User can login with email and password
System supports secure password reset flow via email

events.name: OrderCreated
events.description: Emitted when a new order is successfully created from a customer cart

events.name: OrderConfirmed
events.description: Emitted when customer explicitly confirms their order intent

events.name: OrderCancelled
events.description: Emitted when an order is cancelled by the customer or system before shipping

events.name: PaymentAuthorized
events.description: Emitted when payment authorization is successfully obtained from the gateway

events.name: PaymentCaptured
events.description: Emitted when payment funds are successfully captured from the customer

events.name: OrderPaid
events.description: Emitted after Order Management updates order status to Paid upon consuming PaymentCaptured

events.name: PaymentFailed
events.description: Emitted when payment processing fails at authorization or capture stage

events.name: ShipmentCreated
events.description: Emitted when a shipment record is created in response to an OrderPaid event

events.name: ShipmentDispatched
events.description: Emitted when a shipment is physically handed to the carrier for delivery

events.name: ShipmentDelivered
events.description: Emitted when the carrier confirms successful delivery to the customer

events.name: StockReserved
events.description: Emitted when stock units are successfully reserved for a new order

events.name: StockReservationFailed
events.description: Emitted when stock reservation fails due to insufficient on-hand quantity

events.name: ProductAvailabilityChanged
events.description: Emitted when a product's availability status changes (activated or discontinued)

events.name: CustomerRegistered
events.description: Emitted when a new customer successfully completes registration

messaging.partitioning: By aggregate ID for ordered processing

guarantees.idempotency: consumers must implement idempotent handlers using eventId as deduplication key

contextIntegrations.description: Order Management publishes OrderConfirmed; Payment Processing reacts to authorize and capture payment
Order Management emits OrderPaid; Shipping Context creates the shipment record
Order Management publishes OrderCreated and OrderCancelled; Inventory manages stock reservations and releases
Product Catalog emits ProductAvailabilityChanged; Inventory updates StockItem lifecycle accordingly (e.g., marks as Discontinued)

Order Management queries Product Catalog via its Open Host Service to retrieve product details (price, name, SKU) during checkout. Order Management conforms to the catalog model; an Anti-Corruption Layer is recommended if catalog model stability cannot be guaranteed.

Order Management queries Customer Management via its Open Host Service to retrieve customer identity and saved addresses during order creation. Order Management conforms to the customer model; an Anti-Corruption Layer is recommended for long-term isolation.
